albania.homeSeoTitleEn: Albania citizens travel to China: visa & visa‑free overview 2026
albania.homeSeoDescZh: 阿尔巴尼亚公民前往中国可以享受互免签证，停留90天、240小时过境免签，停留10天，查看全部来华入境规则，材料、有效期、出行避坑与常见问题。
albania.homeSeoDescEn: Guide for Albania citizens travelling to China including mutual visa exemption, stay up to 90 days, 240‑hour transit visa‑free, stay up to 10 days, documents, expiry, pitfalls and FAQs.
albania.homeIntroZh: 阿尔巴尼亚公民可以享受互免签证入境中国，停留90天。阿尔巴尼亚公民可适用240小时过境免签，最长停留10天。出行前请确认对应政策有效期，备好符合要求的护照与出行材料。
albania.homeIntroEn: Albania citizens can enjoy mutual visa exemption for China, stay up to 90 days. Albania citizens can also use the 240‑hour transit visa‑free for up to 10 days. Please check policy expiry and prepare valid travel documents before departure.
homeImportantNotesZh: 无论使用哪一种免签政策，护照建议预留6个月以上有效期以及足够空白签证页。
免签入境不允许从事工作、实习、留学、媒体采访等活动，此类情况需要提前申请签证。
抵达中国后，需要在24小时完成住宿登记，酒店一般会代办。
homeImportantNotesEn: Whichever visa‑free scheme you use, your passport is recommended to have more than 6‑month validity and enough blank pages.
Visa‑free entry cannot be used for work, internship, formal study or media reporting; a proper visa must be applied in advance for these purposes.
Accommodation registration must be completed within 24 hours after arriving in China, usually handled by hotels.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：阿尔巴尼亚公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受互免签证90天、240小时过境免签10天。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Albania citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy mutual visa exemption for 90 days, 240‑hour transit visa‑free for 10 days.

mutual.extraIntroZh: 阿尔巴尼亚公民可以享受互免签证入境中国，停留90天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
mutual.extraIntroEn: Albania citizens are eligible for China's mutual visa exemption for stay up to 90 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit.
mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与阿尔巴尼亚实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，阿尔巴尼亚公民可入境中国90天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与阿尔巴尼亚双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留90天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。
mutual.policyExplainEn: China and Albania implement mutual visa exemption under bilateral agreement. Albania citizens may enter China for up to 90 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 90 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：阿尔巴尼亚公民互免签证入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，根据双边互免协定，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过90天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Albania citizens enter China multiple times under mutual visa exemption?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. Under the bilateral reciprocal agreement, there is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 90 days.

mutual.exclusionNoteZh: 互免签证仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
mutual.exclusionNoteEn: Mutual visa exemption applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

transit.extraIntroZh: 阿尔巴尼亚公民同时可适用240小时过境免签政策，最长停留10天。
transit.extraIntroEn: Albania citizens are also covered by the 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme for maximum 10-day stay.

Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross‑province within permitted zones.

unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa‑free treatment for Argentina citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection

tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.

checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页

✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages

cyprus.homeSeoTitleEn: Cyprus citizens travel to China: visa & visa‑free overview 2026
cyprus.homeSeoDescZh: 塞浦路斯公民前往中国可以享受240小时过境免签，停留10天、单方面30天免签，查看全部来华入境规则，材料、有效期、出行避坑与常见问题。
cyprus.homeSeoDescEn: Guide for Cyprus citizens travelling to China including 240‑hour transit visa‑free, stay up to 10 days, unilateral 30-day visa‑free, documents, expiry, pitfalls and FAQs.
cyprus.homeIntroZh: 塞浦路斯公民可适用240小时过境免签，最长停留10天。塞浦路斯公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境。出行前请确认对应政策有效期，备好符合要求的护照与出行材料。
cyprus.homeIntroEn: Cyprus citizens can also use the 240‑hour transit visa‑free for up to 10 days. Cyprus citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry. Please check policy expiry and prepare valid travel documents before departure.
homeImportantNotesZh: 无论使用哪一种免签政策，护照建议预留6个月以上有效期以及足够空白签证页。
免签入境不允许从事工作、实习、留学、媒体采访等活动，此类情况需要提前申请签证。
抵达中国后，需要在24小时完成住宿登记，酒店一般会代办。
homeImportantNotesEn: Whichever visa‑free scheme you use, your passport is recommended to have more than 6‑month validity and enough blank pages.
Visa‑free entry cannot be used for work, internship, formal study or media reporting; a proper visa must be applied in advance for these purposes.
Accommodation registration must be completed within 24 hours after arriving in China, usually handled by hotels.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：塞浦路斯公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受240小时过境免签10天、单方面免签30天。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Cyprus citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy 240‑hour transit visa‑free for 10 days, unilateral visa‑free for 30 days.

transit.customAlertZh: ⚠️过境免签提示：选择240小时过境免签，必须真正前往第三国，不能以单纯旅游作为入境目的。
transit.customAlertEn: ⚠️Transit visa‑free reminder: Under 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme, you must actually travel onward to a third country; pure tourism is not accepted as entry purpose.
transit.extraIntroZh: 塞浦路斯公民同时可适用240小时过境免签政策，最长停留10天。
transit.extraIntroEn: Cyprus citizens are also covered by the 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme for maximum 10-day stay.
transit.policyExplainZh: 240小时过境免签专为中转旅客设计，核心前提是必须持有已经确认的前往第三国/地区的联程机票，不适合纯粹来华旅游。允许在24个指定省份的开放口岸入境，并且在许可区域内跨省出行。
transit.policyExplainEn: The 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme is designed for connecting transit passengers. Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross‑province within permitted zones.

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：塞浦路斯单方面免签政策自2025-12-01起实施，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Cyprus unilateral visa‑free policy has been in effect since 2025-12-01. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 塞浦路斯公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，适用于经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
unilateral.extraIntroEn: Cyprus citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry for business, tourism, family visit, exchange and transit.
unilateral.policyExplainZh: 中国对塞浦路斯实施单方面免签政策，该政策由中国单方面给予塞浦路斯公民入境便利，并非双边互免协定。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算，目前无入境次数限制。政策存在有效期，到期后规则存在调整可能性。
unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa‑free treatment for Cyprus citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry‑count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：塞浦路斯公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Cyprus citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa‑free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

unilateral.exclusionNoteZh: 单方面免签仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa‑free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry‑count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Germany citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa‑free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa‑free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa‑free treatment for Italy citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry‑count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。

⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。

Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Italy citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa‑free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

peru.homeSeoDescZh: 秘鲁公民前往中国可以享受单方面30天免签，查看全部来华入境规则，材料、有效期、出行避坑与常见问题。
peru.homeSeoDescEn: Guide for Peru citizens travelling to China including unilateral 30-day visa‑free, documents, expiry, pitfalls and FAQs.
peru.homeIntroZh: 秘鲁公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境。出行前请确认对应政策有效期，备好符合要求的护照与出行材料。
peru.homeIntroEn: Peru citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry. Please check policy expiry and prepare valid travel documents before departure.
homeImportantNotesZh: 无论使用哪一种免签政策，护照建议预留6个月以上有效期以及足够空白签证页。
免签入境不允许从事工作、实习、留学、媒体采访等活动，此类情况需要提前申请签证。
抵达中国后，需要在24小时完成住宿登记，酒店一般会代办。
homeImportantNotesEn: Whichever visa‑free scheme you use, your passport is recommended to have more than 6‑month validity and enough blank pages.
Visa‑free entry cannot be used for work, internship, formal study or media reporting; a proper visa must be applied in advance for these purposes.
Accommodation registration must be completed within 24 hours after arriving in China, usually handled by hotels.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：秘鲁公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受单方面30天免签。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Peru citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry.

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：秘鲁单方面免签政策自2025-12-01起实施，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Peru unilateral visa‑free policy has been in effect since 2025-12-01. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 秘鲁公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，适用于经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
unilateral.extraIntroEn: Peru citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry for business, tourism, family visit, exchange and transit.
unilateral.policyExplainZh: 中国对秘鲁实施单方面免签政策，该政策由中国单方面给予秘鲁公民入境便利，并非双边互免协定。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算，目前无入境次数限制。政策存在有效期，到期后规则存在调整可能性。
unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa‑free treatment for Peru citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry‑count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：秘鲁公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Peru citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa‑free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

unilateral.exclusionNoteZh: 单方面免签仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa‑free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与卡塔尔实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，卡塔尔公民可入境中国30天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与卡塔尔双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。
mutual.policyExplainEn: China and Qatar implement mutual visa exemption under bilateral agreement. Qatar citizens may enter China for up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection

⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。

Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

homeImportantNotesZh: 无论使用哪一种免签政策，护照建议预留6个月以上有效期以及足够空白签证页。
免签入境不允许从事工作、实习、留学、媒体采访等活动，此类情况需要提前申请签证。
抵达中国后，需要在24小时完成住宿登记，酒店一般会代办。
homeImportantNotesEn: Whichever visa‑free scheme you use, your passport is recommended to have more than 6‑month validity and enough blank pages.
Visa‑free entry cannot be used for work, internship, formal study or media reporting; a proper visa must be applied in advance for these purposes.
Accommodation registration must be completed within 24 hours after arriving in China, usually handled by hotels.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：塞舌尔公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受互免签证，停留30天。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Seychelles citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy mutual visa exemption for stay up to 30 days.

mutual.extraIntroZh: 塞舌尔公民可以享受互免签证入境中国，停留30天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
mutual.extraIntroEn: Seychelles citizens are eligible for China's mutual visa exemption for stay up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit.
mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与塞舌尔实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，塞舌尔公民可入境中国30天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与塞舌尔双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。
mutual.policyExplainEn: China and Seychelles implement mutual visa exemption under bilateral agreement. Seychelles citizens may enter China for up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：塞舌尔公民互免签证入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，根据双边互免协定，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Seychelles citizens enter China multiple times under mutual visa exemption?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. Under the bilateral reciprocal agreement, there is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

mutual.exclusionNoteZh: 互免签证仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
mutual.exclusionNoteEn: Mutual visa exemption applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

uruguay.homeSeoDescZh: 乌拉圭公民前往中国可以享受单方面30天免签，查看全部来华入境规则，材料、有效期、出行避坑与常见问题。
uruguay.homeSeoDescEn: Guide for Uruguay citizens travelling to China including unilateral 30-day visa‑free, documents, expiry, pitfalls and FAQs.
uruguay.homeIntroZh: 乌拉圭公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境。出行前请确认对应政策有效期，备好符合要求的护照与出行材料。
uruguay.homeIntroEn: Uruguay citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry. Please check policy expiry and prepare valid travel documents before departure.
homeImportantNotesZh: 无论使用哪一种免签政策，护照建议预留6个月以上有效期以及足够空白签证页。
免签入境不允许从事工作、实习、留学、媒体采访等活动，此类情况需要提前申请签证。
抵达中国后，需要在24小时完成住宿登记，酒店一般会代办。
homeImportantNotesEn: Whichever visa‑free scheme you use, your passport is recommended to have more than 6‑month validity and enough blank pages.
Visa‑free entry cannot be used for work, internship, formal study or media reporting; a proper visa must be applied in advance for these purposes.
Accommodation registration must be completed within 24 hours after arriving in China, usually handled by hotels.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：乌拉圭公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受单方面30天免签。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Uruguay citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry.

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：乌拉圭单方面免签政策自2025-12-01起实施，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Uruguay unilateral visa‑free policy has been in effect since 2025-12-01. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 乌拉圭公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，适用于经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
unilateral.extraIntroEn: Uruguay citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa‑free entry for business, tourism, family visit, exchange and transit.
unilateral.policyExplainZh: 中国对乌拉圭实施单方面免签政策，该政策由中国单方面给予乌拉圭公民入境便利，并非双边互免协定。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算，目前无入境次数限制。政策存在有效期，到期后规则存在调整可能性。
unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa‑free treatment for Uruguay citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry‑count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：乌拉圭公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Uruguay citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa‑free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

unilateral.exclusionNoteZh: 单方面免签仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa‑free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross‑province within permitted zones.
